title: the view-level `api` data source is retired in @objectstack/spec (objectstack#23082): delete the `ViewData.provider === 'api'` readers, keep the approvals inbox's code-built `ApiDataSource`
body:
Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` names a release built from objectstack `1912af47b` or later, i.e. one whose `ViewDataSchema` refuses `provider: 'api'`

Filing gate: cross-repo rule 3. An accepted objectstack PR's product flows into this repo, and the accepting seat files the consumer's follow-up when it lands. This card is held (`pm:on-hold`) until the release is installable. The `Restart-when:` line above is the unlock criterion.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader who acts: objectui triage, to route it. `packages/types` is the spec stream, and the renderers are the ui stream; the card may split along that line.

## What landed upstream

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23082 (ruling C, `6134088274`) was carried by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23160, merged as `1912af47b` at 2026-10-13T09:14Z. The view-level `api` data source retires under ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove).
- A view binds its object (`provider: 'object'`) or static rows (`provider: 'value'`). A metadata-declared API call is the page element's `dataSource` binding: the objectstack#23016 rule, same-origin and credential-free.
- `ViewDataSchema` refuses `provider: 'api'` with the prescription `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED`.

## The readers here, measured at objectui `origin/main` `a8051d65`

- `packages/core/src/adapters/resolveDataSource.ts:60`–`:66` builds an `ApiDataSource` from a `ViewData` `api` block. `ApiDataSource.ts:129`'s docblock says "Used when `ViewData.provider === 'api'`".
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1605` and `:2381` branch on `(schema.data as any).provider === 'api'`.
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:832`, `:2064` and `:2585` branch on `provider === 'api'`, and build from the block's `read` / `write`.
- `packages/react/src/hooks/useViewData.ts:124`–`:125` read `read.url` / `write.url` off an `api` block.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:28`–`:29`, `:142` and `:152` re-export spec's `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` and `HttpRequestSchema`. The upstream dev report (`6139676792`) notes that the view schema no longer reads either. Whether objectui keeps a reader for them is part of this card.

**Not a reader of the retired shape:** `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts:257`, `:268` and `:297` build `ApiDataSource` in code from an `ApiDataSourceConfig`, never from a `ViewData`. That route keeps working. The class stays, or re-homes, as a code adapter. objectui#2763 (open, the approvals UI rebuild on the standard renderers) must not route through a `ViewData` `api` block after this. It builds the adapter in code, or binds the page element's `dataSource`.

## Acceptance

Run on the installed release:

- objectui's typecheck passes against the narrowed `ViewData`.
- The reader sites above are deleted. A view block that still says `provider: 'api'` is refused by the parse, never silently rendered.
- The approvals inbox is unchanged, and its tests are green.
- `sdui.manifest.json` regenerates with the pin bump that brings the release in, as the upstream report notes.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `view api data source provider retired ApiDataSource ListView ObjectGantt useViewData spec removal` → 19 hits. One is open: objectui#2763, related as above and not this. The rest are closed and about other view-data or gantt questions. None is this.

Dedupe words: view-level api data source retired; ViewData provider api; ApiDataSource resolveDataSource; VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED.
